Reference

NPC friendship

Every NPC in the game's table, by the map they live on and in the order the seasons open them, with the gifts they like, the friendship ladder and what each friendship level grants you. Names, maps, tags and gift reactions are the game's own text; the season labels follow the same alignment as the Equipment page.

Map 9 has no name in the localisation; its residents are the crossover guests, so that is what the section is called.

The ladder

Every NPC climbs the same 100 levels. The friendship total to reach each band, the title the game gives the bond there, and the promotion you must hold before the band opens:

LevelsBondFriendship to reachNeeds
1–10A New Face4,100—
11–20Someone Familiar10,600Apprentice III
21–30Building Trust19,750Apprentice III
31–40Trusted Friend32,410Apprentice III
41–50Close Companion49,010Elite I
51–60Steadfast Ally69,970Elite II
61–70Kindred Spirit96,020Elite III
71–80Deep Connection127,950Expert I
81–90Unique Bond166,630Expert II
91–100Treasured Above All218,059Expert III
1–10A New Face4,100—
11–20Someone Familiar10,600Apprentice III
21–30Building Trust19,750Apprentice III
31–40Trusted Friend32,410Apprentice III
41–50Close Companion49,010Elite I
51–60Steadfast Ally69,970Elite II
61–70Kindred Spirit96,020Elite III
71–80Deep Connection127,950Expert I
81–90Unique Bond166,630Expert II
91–100Treasured Above All218,059Expert III

Gifts get a warmer line as the bond grows:

  • Lv 1: “It looks nice! Thank you!”
  • Lv 2: “It looks great! Thank you!”
  • Lv 4: “I absolutely love it! Thank you!”

Friendship also pays in stats: each NPC has a bonus curve, and the cards below show what it grants at Lv 50 and Lv 100. Flat ATK, HP, DEF and SPD stack across every NPC you befriend.

Purrwikimania — an independent, fan-made reference for Sword x Staff (Boltray Games). Every number here is read directly out of the game's own configuration files and decompiled code, not from testing or estimation. Item names are the game's official English strings.
